name: H. D. Breene
role: Northern Pacific station agent at Medora
bio: H. D. Breene was the Northern Pacific agent at Medora in 1886, and his name ran under the railroad time table printed in the Cow Boy from January to May that year. In February 1886 he visited Dickinson and Gladstone, and by December 1886 the paper reported him as station agent at Gladstone.
